purpose: Forward-only, internal-only capture of MLB pregame research data (what was known, when, and from where). Never touches public UI, products, money, or settlement. Never backfills missing pregame values from postgame data.

snapshot.snapshotCreatedAt: ISO — capture time (must be < eventStartTime to be research-eligible)
snapshot.rawPayloadHash: sha256/32 of the raw source payload

featureFamilyRecord.availableAt: ISO | null (earliest provable existence; never later than observed; null ⇒ unproven)

eligibilityRule: researchEligible = present AND capturedAt < eventStartTime AND availableAt < eventStartTime AND a proven source timestamp. Ambiguous ⇒ TIMESTAMP_UNPROVEN ⇒ ineligible. Never inferred.
immutability: Snapshots are append-only; a snapshot filename encodes its capture time and is never overwritten. A later source update creates a NEW snapshot; earlier values + timestamps remain recoverable.
forwardOnly: The archive begins at first deployment. No historical coverage is claimed for prior dates. No family is backfilled from postgame data.

collectionGate.note: Challenger modeling may begin only after this gate is met AND founder approval — a separate later mission.
